versions.changelog:
Version 0.1.0

- Initial release of Work Productivity Ontology Typed Workflow Helper.
- Provides practical support for ontology-style workflows including bug fixes, hardening, reliability, and adjacent skill creation.
- Addresses validated demand, with evidence from 12 signals across 3 source families.
- Offers local-hardware friendly outputs such as checklists, templates, and scripts.
- Delivers tailored artifacts, reusable workflows, and verification notes per user requirements.

- Initial release of work-productivity-ontology-typed-workflow-helper.
- Provides practical workflow, checklist, and artifact creation for ontology-style work productivity needs.
- Addresses validated demand for ontology-based workflows in agent-driven environments, with special focus on bug fixing, reliability, and adjacent skill creation.
- Delivers clear steps for restating user needs, building local-hardware-friendly workflows, and validating results.
- Includes guidance for reusable outputs and verification notes to improve repeatability and actionability.
